title: 6j-symbol equivalence from isomorphic TQFTs

statement_paraphrase: Determine the relation between fusion-rule algebras and their 6j-symbols when the associated ordinary three-dimensional TQFTs are isomorphic; the source remark specifically asks about Sato equivalence.
